value.rationale: Fixed-horizon tuning of a standard graph-averaging filter in an edge-BV stability norm is a motivated stability-design invariant. The theorem supplies an all-leaf-count/all-horizon attained exact norm and unique optimizer, distinguishes every even horizon from odd horizons, identifies the first interior odd-horizon transition at four leaves, and shows universal exact scalar smoothing of edge gradients at two steps and all even horizons. These facts distinguish spectral asymptotic mixing from finite-step signal perturbation stability and are not arbitrary small computations.
